subject: Can't deploy app:  "Could not resolve host"

messages.author: 04d86603ca82df5d
messages.subject: Can't deploy app:  "Could not resolve host"
parts:
Hi,


I am trying to deploy an app. It returns the error:

Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io; Name or service not known
Calls: <Anonymous> ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
Timing stopped at: 0.055 0.011 0.175

right away. I deployed essentially the same thing yesterday, when it was no problem. I tried this from my local machine as well as my R Studio server. 
Can anyone help me what the deal is here? To me it reads like the service is down, but that can't be it. I have not touched any tokens etc as far as I can remember. 
I tried looking on here but could not find anything too helpful and appreciate any help! 
Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Can't deploy app:  "Could not resolve host"
parts: There is currently an issue with the .io top-level domain provider which is causing resolution issues. We are trying to learn more now.
